notes.title: Post-Launch Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h3][b]Transmission: Moros Protocol Post-Launch Patch 1.0.5 Deployed[/b][/h3][p] The system has been re-calibrated. Anomalies identified in the previous cycle have been addressed, stability reinforced and core functions optimised. Field operatives should experience a smoother synchronisation with protocol parameters moving forward.  [/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h3][b]Weapons[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]DualStr8Fires:[/b] Fixed a bug that lowered the volume of the shots the longer you hold the trigger.[/p][/*][*][p][b]DualStr8Fires:[/b] Bullet cost is now decreased (3 ammo per shot -> 1 ammo per shot) and accuracy is now increased (75% -> 90%).[/p][/*][*][p][b]MRPG Launcher:[/b] Damage adjusted to fit the other Tier 2 weapons (40 dmg per shot -> 32 damage per shot).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Toggle sprint:[/b] Fixed a bug that during the activation of sprint toggle, the player was performing a run jump instead of a normal jump.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toggle sprint:[/b] Having the toggle sprint on, holding the charge attack and then press heal, the player was able to run during the healing animation. Now this situation is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sprint:[/b] The player is now able to attack with melee or ranged but cancels the sprint.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sprint:[/b] While stationary, holding down the "Sprint” key or toggle doesn't take away the crosshair.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stamina:[/b] Stamina regeneration during run was activated after the auto-save during the beginning of the run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI:[/b] Disabled input reading when the game is out of focus that fixes some issues with stuck UI.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound:[/b] Raised the volume of the co-op player's footsteps and other actions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map:[/b] Fixed a bug where client (player) could select a path on the level map (thus breaking the run) when selecting with a controller.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Bosses [/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Boss Mother:[/b] Mother's spawns had a rare bug, that during their attack they were sticking on the player.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Mother:[/b] Fixed a bug that the cutscene collider has been activated to teleport the other player to the entrance of the arena during the fight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Mother:[/b] Boss pathfinding height fixed. That change fixed jump attack shockwave hiding under the floor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Big Brother Boss:[/b] Fixed a bug that gave the player a black screen after the intro cutscene (Possible fix on player losing control after cutscene).[/p][/*][*][p][b]All Bosses:[/b] Fixed a bug that restrained the Bosses change player target, now there is a slight chance to change target after every attack.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Rooms[/b] [/h3][list][*][p][b]Barracks Area:[/b] Fixes on maps including softlocks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secret Rooms:[/b] Vending machines now have their collisions fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Starting Hub area:[/b] Visual fixes.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Systems[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]System/ Graphics:[/b] Added Windowed and Fullscreen resolution option.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controls/ Key Binding:[/b] Added horizontal and vertical movement keys remapping to the keybinds menu (lacking localisation).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Co-op:[/b] Disallowed lobbies where players are on different numerical versions of the game (for example one is on 1.0.0 and the other is on 1.0.1, steam/gog cross-play unaffected).[/p][/*][*][p]Title Screen: Added version displayed next to the copyright message.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Don't forget, your field reports carry weight. Leaving a review on Steam not only strengthens the project, it helps us unlock new [b]review milestones[/b] and expand the reach of the Protocol. Every entry accelerates development.
[/p][p]For deeper intel, real-time updates and direct anomaly reporting, [url="https://discord.gg/F9RYpe5HFX"]join us on the official Moros Protocol Discord.[/url] Your vigilance ensures the system remains stable.

[b]See you in the stars 💫[/b] [/p][p]- Pixel Reign 🚀[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605250/Moros_Protocol/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary #13 - Weapons and Augments #4
notes.content:
[b][i]Know your enemy! That's a core tenet of being an Orphean. Whether you're fighting Freorra Corpos or alien threats, you must understand them. And what better way than to use their own weapons against them.[/i][/b]

[h2]Weapons & Augments #4[/h2]
We've loved all the support you've given us thoroughout our recent playtests, however, there's still plenty of weapons & augments you haven't seen! Let's talk about some of them today.

[h2]WEAPONS[/h2]
[h3]Absolver ⚔️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/cd6094ae70b3643abf64b39a2184af8233bcbf0b.png[/img]
A mechanical chainsaw blade designes specifically for cutting tough flesh and bones. Standard Catharis anti-darkphage weapon.

[h3]Burning Heat🔫[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/1617816c96f78086bc387b4d1525c45970f4df88.png[/img]
Originally created by a cook with a passion for burning things, this makeshift flamethrower is now a classic DIY recipe found in space web, which you can quickly make with things you find in a spaceship kitchen.

[h2]AUGMENTS[/h2]
[h3]Bloody Aid ⬆️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/e19a4ab1c4f098fa79bbf804bafad747204ab460.png[/img]
The monsters of the Darkphage are snappy and vicious. The likelyhood of getting slashed, bitten and shot are very high. However, this isn't all negative. If you pick up an augment like Bloody Aid, you turn 25% of damage received is fills your healing shot meter every time you get hit.

[h3]Stay Healthy ⬆️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/3eb574c1094743ee856155b1e36d1316e680051a.png[/img]
Healthy Melee & Healthy Weapons are upgrades for the masters of doding. If you believe you can keep your health at full, then these augments are for you. When at full HP, increase Melee weapon damage by 60% or increase Ranged weapon damage by 50% respectively.

Thanks for reading through! We're very excited to announce that our [b]FINAL Playtest[/b] kicks off tomorrow at 4pm BST. Get ready to fight through even more of the Orpheus past the Jocaste fight. See you in the stars 💫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/b65cd3899b430376179b4a3436f68491a1d846e7.png[/img]

- Pixel Reign 🚀

[h2]Be sure to wishlist👇[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605250/Moros_Protocol/

notes.title: Moros Protocol - Steam Next Fest Starts Now 💥
notes.content:
[i][b]"When stars awaken, so too does our hubris. For in rising, we believe we outshine the light."
— Juk' Haram, Essence Prime, 16:17

Today you will understand the light of order.
Today is your salvation, insect.[/b][/i]

[h1]Steam Next Fest has begun 💥[/h1]
The time has arrived, Orpheans. Today, you shall take on the Sin Seeker... [b]Jocaste ⚔️[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/3524cfe56f1d7ca651042462e9c5fc50f867dd70.png[/img]

Steam Next Fest is now live, which means it's time for Moros Protocol to have the biggest demo that we've ever had. Are you ready for brand new weapons, augments and enemies to battle againt. Make your way to our Steam page today and download the demo.

[h2]Patch Notes - V0.16.3[/h2]
[b]Headlines[/b] [list]
[*] [b]Jocaste the Sin Seeker[/b] boss battle is unlocked.
[*] Enabled more [b]Bioboost upgrades.[/b]
[*] Introducing [b]intrusive augments.[/b]
These augments are more powerful than what you'd typically see, but they all come at a cost. And once they've been attached, they take up a permanent slot for the rest of your run. So, use them with care!
[/list]
[b]New Weapons[/b] [list]
[*] [b]Nuclei-55 Disintegrator[/b] (Energy)
HWT's Nuclei-55 series adds a little sparkling insult to injury as the ordinance for these weapons is infused with thermodynamic nanotechnology. Due to the splash particles when in contact with the target, caution is advised to maintain a safe distance from the blast.
[*] [b]XM LED Strobe[/b] (Energy)
Originally taken from 8th-Generation mining lasers and repurposed into a handheld cannon, XM LED Strobe was the tool used by the Mining factions of Gravel-3 System to oppose their captors and overturn slavery. Highly controversial design due to the lack of a failsafe in case of a fall.
[*] [b]Type-9 Boomstick[/b] (Physical)
A simple and reliable design adopted by the Acantha X Spec-ops. Type-9 is a practical side weapon capable of operating in the most extreme conditions.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/046be3962ab19f04e049fe52ba2af70b42d5a250.png[/img]

notes.title: Moros Protocol Playtest #4 - Now Live!
notes.content:
[b][i]Soldiers stick together. That's a core tenet Orpheans believe in fervently. Facing the universe alone is a curse.[/i][/b]

Good day, Orpheans!

Our 4th playtest is now live! This playtest brings a big change... [b]Co-op is now available.[/b]
Grab a friend and face the darkness... together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/0879a3da5d07d7c18d59f3fc3d15f771ac440450.gif[/img]

[h3]How to join the playtest[/h3]
Head over to the [i]Moros Protocol[/i] Steam page and hit the "Request Access" button on the playtest.
The Playtest app should now be available in your Steam library. This process might take a minute, so refresh if it doesn't pop up immediately.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[b]New Weapons 💥 [/b] [list]
[*] [b]The Conduit (Melee)[/b]
One of a series of bladed weapons rumoured to have been crafted by a mad engineer deep in the ship’s bowels with a penchant for pain and a sprinkle of surprise. Though its creation was bound for fire-fighting, a downward swing is bound to cut most non-metal materials easily.
[*] [b]The Dual Str8Fires (Physical)[/b]
Repurposed from forgotten Earth tech, Str8Fires are lightweight submachine guns that are perfect for dual-hand showdowns. These weapons are the definition of "spray and pray", as their large magazines also act as recoil compensators and prevent unwanted muzzle rise [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/46206aa5a329ee09e6594ac6db3a0aa6edd0775a.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/b3589a348f73b323fcf3e722efc0c21ac617c89a.png[/img]
[b]New Content[/b] [list]
[*] Online Co-op is now available in the main menu.
[*] Enabled more Bioboost upgrades.
[*] Added Challenge Rooms.
[*] Two new enemy types - [b]Darkster Larvae[/b] & [b]Variant Zombie[/b] [/list]
[b]Changes & Bug Fixes[/b] [list]
[*] Kick now destroys cocoons and Secret Room doors.
[*] During the loading screen (travel screen), the screen now fades to full black.
[*] Spitclaw weapon has new visual effects; its projectile now deals area-of-effect damage.
[*] Fixed area-of-effect damage on enemies.
[*] Ranged weapon fire rate now remains consistent during weapon swapping.
[*] Fixed enemies spawning on top of boxes and interactables.
[*] Damage numbers now shrink after reaching a certain size to avoid obstructing the player's view.
[*] Dodge behaviour changed: melee attacks no longer track, but ranged attacks still do.
[*] Adjusted spawn areas for enemies.
[*] Slot animations are now faster.
[*] Corruption mechanics have been adjusted.
[*] Chest opening trigger is now more forgiving.
[*] Items and pickups are now disabled during cutscenes.
[*] Duplicate resolutions are now hidden in the settings menu when the OS reports the same resolution multiple times (per refresh rate). FPS remains a separate setting. [/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
With the release of Co-op, we know there are some issues that may arise. Here are some problems you might face and how to work around them. Always feel free to message us in our Discord server or in the Steam forums if you have any issues! [list]
[*] [b]Co-op[/b]  - Desync may be possible in subsequent co-op sessions.,
[i]Workaround[/i]: After each co-op session, it is advised to [b]close/relaunch the title[/b] to start another co-op session afresh.
[*] [b]Screen Resolution[/b] - Changing resolutions may cause display issues
[i]Workaround [/i](to default): Delete the PixelReign folder in Registry Editor. To find this:
- Search and open up [i]Registry Editor[/i]
- Open [i]HKEY_CURRENT_USER folder[/i]
- Open [i]Software[/i] folder
- Locate the [b]PixelReign[/b] folder.
- Delete the [b]PixelReign[/b] folder.
[/list]
Have fun! This is our most exciting playtest so far. See you in the stars 💫

- Pixel Reign 🚀

notes.title: Dev Diary #8 - What the Darkphage Leaves Behind
notes.content:
[b][i]It has seeded the infinite void with denizens of hatred. It waits in silence, until the pride of mankind demands correction. Unfettered, it brings lasting equality through annihilation. It is destruction incarnate. It is the Darkphage.[/i][/b]

[h2]Echoes in the Dark[/h2]
Something unnatural has taken hold aboard the Orpheus. Its crew changed, Its corridors stalked by things that shouldn’t exist. Today, we're revealing some of the threats you'll encounter in [i][b]Moros Protocol[/b][/i].

[h3]Larvae[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/c151367a30c02160145b92380fd66d3b558753f1.png[/img]

These creatures scuttle through the Orpheus with an unsettling purpose; seeking out the living. Small and fragile at first, they’re easy to dispatch... but don’t get comfortable. The longer they persist, the more they change. And the more dangerous they become.

[h3]Twisted Orpheans[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/f143cb39a5bf797523032e532ee2a69eb729fb3c.png[/img]

Once-human figures now roam the halls, grotesquely altered. They move with brute force but sluggish steps, as if dragged by something within. Their glowing chests may hint at a weakness, but facing them means confronting what your crewmates have become.

[h3]Nychoraptors[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/50ec194179fab53b1da500140eaaa4f782014ee0.png[/img]

These creatures no longer resemble anything from the Orpheus. Fast, vicious, and disturbingly agile, they are the stuff of nightmares. Watch for the glint of an eye where one should never be... targeting it may be your only chance.

Thank you for reading, and get ready for our playtest this weekend. You might want to grab a friend as co-op kicks off tomorrow! See you in the stars 💫

- Pixel Reign 🚀

notes.title: Dev Diary #7 - Meet ODY-6
notes.content:
[b][i]The Acantha X Corporation is proud to present the latest in our military robotics line - the ODY-6 Sentry Support Bot! Protection is at your beck and call with this brand new mechanical marvel, boasting a range of in-battle capabilities that will support you in the fight.
When you're lost in the darkness, the ODY-6 will light the way![/i][/b]

[b]Your ODY-6 Sentry Support Bot[/b]
The Orpheus is a dark and dangerous place, but luckily you have an [b]ODY-6[/b] by your side! Created as a "Soldier's Best Friend" for the Acantha X - Freorra war, they are the perfect multi-tool for many problems that any [i]Orphean [/i]might come across.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/efa7c100688589babb26f157835d06b2d2e089b3.png[/img]

No matter how bad it gets, the [i]ODY-6[/i] is there to support. Typically, you'd only see an [i]Acanthan[/i] officer or special operative have an [i]ODY-6[/i] unit at their command... however, after waking up on the Orpheus, this unit seems to have attached itself to your biometrics. How lucky!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/d0f22389d5d11c94fdf38d90d6ef60621c17341c.gif[/img]

If it wasn't for [i]ODY-6[/i], it'd be near impossible to get around the Orpheus. Especially when it comes to opening locked doorways, hacking terminals, and opening chests. That's right, it's so much more than a flashlight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/52c1fdd7bc56be805033915acc734c5b093c95ea.gif[/img]

Thanks for reading! We've got some big updates coming to our next playtest on the [b]23rd of May[/b]. Be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/avxrcZz7sT]join our Discord channel[/url] to get the latest updates. See you in the stars 💫

- Pixel Reign 🚀

notes.title: Moros Protocol Playtest #2 - Now Live
notes.content:
[i][b]Soldier X394 Deep Space Report. I watch as infected prance across the ship, adapting their very bones into weaponry that mimics our own. This report might cost me my life, but if it helps another, that's all I can ask for. They are changing, learning, adapting. Gods protect us.[/b][/i]

The ship still needs you, Orpheans!

Get ready to jump back into Moros Protocol right now. We've got some brand new weapons and an expanded upgrade path to experiment with more. See if you can defeat Big Brother with more weapons and upgrades.

[h2]New Weapons 💥 [/h2] [list]
[*] [b]Twin Thunder (Melee)[/b]
Akantha's ceremonial sword, used in officer promotion rituals. Boasting two opposing electroplasm emitters, this blade damages your opponent twice per swing.
[*] [b]Spitclaw (Energy) [/b]
An energy generating gland from a Darkphage, it can manipulate magnetic fields to create and propel balls of plasma.  Seems to be able to sustain itself if given enough food. 
 [/list]
[h2]Changes and Fixes 🛠️ [/h2] [list]
[*] Bioboost now unlocks 4 more upgrades in the demo.
[*] Fixed death messages to progress correctly.
[*]Fixed Boss [b]Brother[/b] not appearing after zombie spawns; he now appears after some time even if zombies haven't been killed.
[*] Fixed keycard dialogue.
[*] Added first encounter dialogue.
[*] Fixed mini shotgun to be included in weapon chest drops.
[*] Fixed UI update when max HP changes due to unequipping an augment.
[*] Fixed player HP going below 0.
[*] Consumable container is now never empty.
[*] Updated HP UI when max HP changes.
[*] Fixed firstspawn tag being set in the tutorial.
[*] Reset camera, weapon, and companion when the player is enabled to ensure proper state after cutscenes.
[*] Prevented enemies from spawning on top of boxes.
[*] Fixed thrown weapon damage description showing as 0.
[*] Fixed unequipped weapon damage description not calculating full charge damage for charging weapons.
[*] World button names on the title screen now appear as "???" if not unlocked.
[*] Added a quit button to the Bioboost menu (was missing animation).
[*] Fixed weapon upgrade vendor not properly applying changes to weapon stats.
[*] Adjusted rules for secret room and corruption placement.
[*] Adjusted rules for wall vendor placement.
[*] General graphical polishes. [/list]
The playtest will be live until Monday the 28th of April at 4pm BST. Have fun playing, and we'll see you in the stars! ✨

- Pixel Reign 👑

notes.content:
[h3]Hello fellow soldiers,

This is Abbey speaking

Your job was amazing. Due to your tireless effort, your meticulous spirit and above all, your noble courage, we managed to detect different kind of bugs. We are proud to report that these bugs have been isolated, tested and eliminated.

We proudly salute you![/h3]

[*] Improved AI’s voice messages for lockdown and added more variations
